Title: HeatWave USA Recalls HW-1500 Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
Description: This recall involves HeatWave space heaters, model HW-1500, sold in white.

Hazards.Name: The heater can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards.

Remedies.Name: Stop using the heater and contact HeatWave for a full refund.

Importers.Name: HeatWave USA Inc., of Columbus, Ohio

Title: Brightline Recalls Children's Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Burn Injury
Description: This recall involves children's two-piece pajama sets in sizes 2T to 10.

Hazards.Name: The pajamas violate the flammability regulations for children's sleepwear.

Remedies.Name: Stop using the pajamas and contact Brightline for a refund.

Title: Kettleworks Recalls Electric Kettles Due to Shock Hazard
Description: This recall involves Kettleworks electric kettles, models KW-10, KW-12 and KW-15.

Hazards.Name: The base can expose live parts, posing a shock hazard.

Remedies.Name: Stop using the kettle and contact Kettleworks for a replacement base.
